timeline.headline: ITALIAN GOVERNMENT EXPECTED TO FALL TOMORROW

timeline.text: Italy's government is expected to fall tomorrow after the majority Christian Democrats decided to withdraw their 16 ministers unless Socialist Prime Minister Bettino Craxi resigned, political sources said today.
timeline.headline: ITALIAN GOVERNMENT EXPECTED TO FALL TOMORROW

timeline.text: If he refused to do so and insisted on a full debate they would withdraw their ministers, forcing the collapse of the government before a confidence vote, the sources said.
timeline.headline: ITALIAN GOVERNMENT EXPECTED TO FALL TOMORROW
